problem: Which of the following equations is an instance of the Cauchy-Euler equation?
worked_solution:
The second-order Cauchy–Euler equation has the form

$$
a{t}^{2}{y}^{″}+bt{y}^{′}+cy=f(t),
$$

where $a,b,$ and $c$ are constants.

Of the given equations, the only equation that has the above form is

$$
2{t}^{2}{y}^{″}+4t{y}^{′}-3y=0.
$$
